deductions.fix: Serve fingerprinted static assets with Cache-Control: max-age=31536000, immutable; avoid no-store.
Give every page a unique, descriptive <title> (avoid reusing the same title across pages).
Write a unique meta description per page summarizing its content (~50-160 chars).
Add the missing security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options) and harden cookies (Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite).
Associate every form control with a <label> (for=id or wrapping) or an aria-label.
Use heading levels in order (don't jump from <h2> to <h4>).
Enable Brotli (or at least gzip) compression for text assets on the server/CDN.
Serve images in a modern format (WebP or AVIF) for better compression.
Consider AVIF for the best image compression (alongside or instead of WebP).

Content-Security-Policy is set but weakened by 'unsafe-inline' which significantly reduces its XSS protection.
Feature-Policy header is not set. It allows enabling/disabling browser APIs and features for security. Not important if Permissions-Policy is set.
Permissions-Policy header is not set. It allows enabling/disabling browser APIs and features for security.
Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy is not set. 'same-origin' isolates your browsing context from cross-origin popups (mitigates Spectre/XS-Leaks).
Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy is not set. 'require-corp' enables cross-origin isolation for powerful features.
Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy is not set. 'same-origin' or 'same-site' blocks other sites from embedding this resource.
